name: Sarah Mitchell
bio: With over 12 years of experience in residential real estate, Sarah specializes in luxury homes and waterfront properties. She has consistently been a top performer in the Austin market.

name: James Rodriguez
bio: James brings 8 years of commercial and residential expertise to every transaction. His background in architecture gives clients a unique perspective on property value.

name: Emily Chen
bio: Emily is a first-time homebuyer specialist who makes the buying process simple and stress-free. She has helped over 200 families find their dream homes in the greater Austin area.

name: Michael Thompson
bio: A seasoned investor-focused agent, Michael helps clients build wealth through strategic real estate investments. He manages a portfolio of over $50M in rental properties.

name: Jessica Park
bio: Jessica focuses on eco-friendly and sustainable properties. She is LEED-certified and passionate about helping clients find energy-efficient homes.

name: David Williams
bio: David has been selling luxury properties for over 15 years. His deep knowledge of the Hill Country market and attention to detail make him a trusted advisor for high-net-worth clients.

name: Amanda Foster
bio: Amanda specializes in downtown condos and urban living. She knows every neighborhood in Austin and helps young professionals find the perfect city apartment.

name: Robert Kim
bio: Robert is a relocation specialist who assists families moving to Texas from out of state. His comprehensive market knowledge and concierge-level service ensure a smooth transition.
